status: ADAPTER_PREPARED_NOT_RUN (no strategy fit, no TEST, no trading)
shared_files: none; tools/i6dmo is imported as a namespace portion, this lane does not create tools/i6dmo/__init__.py

strategy_pin.base: origin/master 5c87a25 (legacy plugin blob 3a19b3f and policy blob 0940589 unchanged)
strategy_pin.load: git show <commit>:<path> from the heuristic-strategy object store, blob and sha256 verified, executed as an isolated module; never via the heuristic_strategy.plugins entry point or sys.path
strategy_pin.repo_resolution: $I6DMO_STRATEGY_REPO, else <checkout>/../heuristic-strategy, else <main-repo-of-worktree>/../heuristic-strategy; deploy must fetch the pinned branch on every host role that runs a pair unit

plugin_map: STRATEGY_PLUGIN_MAP.json: in the default interpreter the entry point resolves to an installed 2025 copy (sha256 3e1ebec1...), not the inspected checkout; the executor uses only the pinned blob

python_api.build_family_heads(origin, family, predi: record keys: family, index (position only), horizon_hours, role, origin, target_timestamp, eligible_until, week_id, operational_eligible, available, value (None unless available), reason
python_api.family_predictions_from_arrays(row_id, h: consumes the model lane predictions/*.npz arrays by horizons_hours; the label mask is NOT consumed (it depends on future label existence)
python_api.entry_decision_from_records(policy, curr: long family only; ABSTAIN INSUFFICIENT_LONG_HEADS below min_valid_long_heads
python_api.management_decision(policy, direction, t: EARLY_CLOSE/SL_FIRST, HOLD/TP_FIRST, HOLD/NO_SAMPLED_CROSSING, HOLD/NO_AVAILABLE_HEADS; consulted and skipped heads are receipted (U_h source)
python_api.pair_eligibility(short_report, long_repo: report = {str(h): {mae, naive, n, [eligible]}}; strict MAE<naive; status ELIGIBLE | PAIR_NOT_ELIGIBLE with missing[]
python_api.run_backtest(bars, weeks, short_predicti: trades, open_positions, cancelled_orders, failures, decisions (receipts), position_at, equity_curve, metrics, references; TEST_FORBIDDEN for any instant >= 2025-01-01 unless allow_test

consumed_contracts.predictions: model lane predictions/{validation}.npz: row_id (origin epoch s), horizons_hours, predicted_price (n,6) original USD/EUR
consumed_contracts.calendar: C1 tools.i6n_contracts.eligibility.load_calendar config (versioned weeks O, C, K; offsets 12/12); an assumed FX calendar stays labelled as assumed
consumed_contracts.bars: REQUESTED FROM DATA LANE: hourly EURUSD OHLC, close_time = instant the bar closes (bar covers (close_time-1h, close_time]); gaps allowed; split-bounded
consumed_contracts.eligibility_reports: report units' {horizon_hours: {mae, naive, eligible, n}} per family (ops TERMINAL.eligibility)

execution_rules: tools.i6dmo.strategy_adapter.EXECUTION_RULES (next-bar-open fills, force-close trigger t >= B-1h with fill by B, missing fill retained, SL first when both barriers touch in one bar, separate spread/slippage/commission/swap lines, one position per asset, 120-hour frequency window)
metrics: sharpe and sortino (UTC-day mark-to-market returns, 260 periods/year)
not_implemented_here: the ops child entry `python -m tools.i6dmo.strategy run-unit` for the PAIR_VALIDATION unit; integration wires pair_eligibility + run_backtest after the long family closes. No pair run is possible before both families have report terminals.
